description: This file contains Makefile definitions and functions related to building firmware images for specific devices (Senao and Watchguard), including steps for creating sysupgrade images, checksum calculations, and loader configurations.

methods.name: Build/senao-tar-gz
methods.description: Defines a build process for creating a compressed firmware archive with required headers, checksums, and environment setup scripts for Senao devices.

methods.name: Build/watchguard-cksum
methods.description: Defines a checksum calculation procedure for Watchguard firmware components.

methods.name: Device/senao_loader_okli
methods.description: Configures loader settings and image creation commands for Senao devices using the okli loader.
